headlines.text: Back on this day in 2025, the inaugural AEW TBS Title was crowned as Mercedes Mone vs. Mina Shirakawa went to war, appearing on WrestleDream, rated 6.41. Mon? defeated Mina Shirakawa to retain the TBS Championship and win the interim ROH Women's World TV Title, capping a whirlwind week that saw her add four championships in three countries.

Back on this day in 2022, Jon Moxley vs. Adam Page clashed for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.84. It was the 30th time the AEW World Heavyweight Title had been on the line, a significant milestone for the title. Adam Page was chasing gold for the 10th time. Moxley's World Title defense against Page turned brutally physical and ended early after a legitimate concussion from a clothesline forced the referee to stop the match
On a Wednesday in 2023, back when Kenny Omega vs. Kyle Fletcher delivered a hard-hitting, high-quality battle on Dynamite, rated 8.02.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2025, when the AEW World Tag Team Titles was up for grabs as Brodido vs. Okada & Takeshita went to war, appearing on WrestleDream, rated 8.93 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype. Okada & Takeshita was challenging for gold for the very first time. Brodido retained the AEW World Tag Team Titles over Okada and Takeshita, with cracks showing in the Don Callis Family as Takeshita walked off frustrated by Okada's attitude.

On this day in 2025, Kyle Fletcher vs. Mark Briscoe went to battle over the AEW TNT Title, appearing on WrestleDream, rated 8.34 ? a real highlight of the night. Fletcher retained the TNT Championship over Briscoe in a 24-minute battle, extending his reign as one of the Don Callis Family's top stars.

2025 brought us this moment: Darby Allin vs. Jon Moxley fought it out in an I Quit match, topping the bill that night on WrestleDream, rated 8.12 ? a real highlight of the night in a hard-fought men's division clash ? part of a stacked WrestleDream '25 card, rated 8.20 overall. With help from his old tag partner Sting, Allin defeated Moxley in a brutal "I Quit" match to deal a major blow to the Death Riders.
